provenance.fixture: dataset_monstree/mini6 (configuration above, enforced by the runner). A seeded run also passes FeatureExtraction.num_threads 1 (sorted image ids) and TwoViewGeometry.random_seed.
provenance.rule: Count metrics are discrete, so any difference is algorithmic and the threshold is 0. Each continuous threshold is the log-space midpoint sqrt(noise_floor * smallest_algorithmic_divergence), rounded to one significant digit, so it keeps the same number of decades of margin against both. It is never fitted to the candidate.

noise_floor.method: Upstream 3e5c915c default build versus the same source built with -ffp-contract=off, same host and inputs, through this runner; repeated runs of both pairs were bit-identical
noise_floor.notes: Counts were identical. The measured reprojection difference was exactly 0, so the double-precision relative resolution 1e-14 is used. The rotation floor equals the acos resolution near identity (acos(1 - 2^-53) = 8.5e-7 deg), not a pose difference.

smallest_algorithmic_divergence.method: Same database, isolated mapper: ACloudViewer with std::unordered hash containers versus upstream boost::unordered 1.92 (iteration-order divergence of the SfM gauge and BA residual order)

provenance.scope: Same-host gate only. A different CPU, compiler, or BLAS can move the floating-point floor and requires re-measuring both inputs of the rule.
